articles.title: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
articles.description: The US treasury secretary says allies will need to decide whether they "are with us or against us".

articles.title: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says
articles.description: At least 17 people were killed in the "massive attack" overnight on Ukraine's capital, as mayor Vitali Klitschko warns hot water supply has been disrupted.

articles.title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
articles.description: Lebanon handed over former General Adel Issa, as Syria steps up its pursuit of wanted members of the former regime.

articles.title: 'Don't rape, sexually assault or make kissing noises', asylum seekers warned in new guidance about living in UK
articles.description: A guide for asylum seekers published by the Home Office has told them not to rape or sexually harass people, including partners and children.
